find: liftChildren( st, rowRec, copies, held, { fillElement, snapsOf } );
why: a differing value would be dropped or never reach the icon
only the first slot of an element would be read, losing the settings calibrated elsewhere
a circle would stay a radius row

find: const skipped = ( attr ) => childAttr.has( attr ) && held.has( keyOf( childAttr.get( attr ) ) );
why: an icon would carry what the row already holds
a non-square box would become circle
an element no setting is calibrated on would be silent
longhand rows of a property the row holds would be raised on the icon
a draft element would be read as a ::before layer and every property it paints raised there
